Stratum: a .NET 10 microservice generator with your team's conventions (CLI, visual editor and MCP server). Generador de microservicios .NET con las convenciones de tu equipo.

Stratum messaging between services: integration events through an outbox (no event lost if the broker is down), idempotent consumers (inbox), retries and dead-letter, tracing across services. Broker-agnostic: add Stratum.Messaging.Kafka or Stratum.Messaging.AzureServiceBus. Framework-only.

Azure Service Bus broker for Stratum.Messaging: one topic per integration event, one subscription per service, completes after handling, native dead-letter queue. Works with Aspire's Service Bus resource and its local emulator (connection string "servicebus").
Stratum service defaults: health checks, ProblemDetails, correlation id, validated options. Framework-only, no third-party dependencies.

Kafka broker for Stratum.Messaging (Confluent.Kafka): one topic per integration event, one consumer group per service, manual commits after handling, dead-letter topic, topics created on demand. Works with Aspire's Kafka resource (connection string "kafka").
Stratum service defaults for HTTP clients: standard resilience pipeline (retry, timeout, circuit breaker) and service discovery (http://orders resolved by Aspire or configuration).
Stratum DDD building blocks: aggregates, domain events, domain exceptions, commands, queries and handler contracts. No dependencies, safe to reference from a Domain project.
Stratum service defaults: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs with OTLP export.
